baseline_kernel: installed sgl-kernel 0.4.4 FlashMLA SM100 flash_fwd_splitkv_mla_fp8_sparse_kernel plus flash_fwd_mla_combine_kernel

bottleneck.evidence: The scheduler-corrected one-lease campaign measured zero main-to-combine host gap with 4.096 us stock M16 PDL overlap. NCU measured the M16 main at 14.21 percent SM throughput, 13.24 percent DRAM peak, 18.45 percent achieved occupancy, and 375/1054 long-scoreboard plus 373/1054 barrier PC samples. Stock M16 combine launches only 128 blocks on 148 SMs, reads 16818176 bytes with 0.505 percent L2 hit rate, and has 271/390 long-scoreboard samples. The bound-32 candidate still reads 16817152 bytes with 0.470 percent L2 hit rate and increases long-scoreboard samples to 298/401. The binding limit is sparse-gather latency plus synchronization and grid underfill, not compute or a removable launch gap.

approaches.summary: Revalidated the pinned stock-source overlay against the installed extension in eager and real CUDA Graph modes while keeping all paired sessions and profilers on physical GPU 1 under one flexible scheduler lease.
approaches.why: All 12 rebuild-control sessions missed the 3 percent threshold; eager M16/M32 median-session speedups were 1.013117/1.007534 and graph M16/M32 were 0.991351/0.989923, so the overlay establishes noise and build provenance but is not an optimization.

approaches.summary: Used an exact SM100 M16 sparse-FP8 predicate to dispatch the existing combine bound-32 body, reducing static shared allocation while preserving main-kernel, scheduler, metadata, stream, PDL, buffers, M32, and stock fallback semantics.
approaches.why: Candidate eager session speedups were 1.024761/1.014102/1.016634 at M16 and 1.004522/1.021972/0.998688 at M32, while all graph sessions regressed at 0.989357/0.990007/0.989124 and 0.992105/0.985662/0.991270; the 1.36 percent single-trace chain delta did not survive paired graph measurement.

lesson: Keep an entire alternating reference/candidate campaign and its profiler collection on one dynamically allocated physical GPU, then gate short PDL-overlapped paths on real CUDA Graph replay. Reducing compile-time combine state is not useful when it leaves sparse-gather bytes, a 128-block tail, and long-scoreboard pressure unchanged.
